title: DIY vs. hire-out cost and effort comparison
description: Estimate DIY and hire-out paths in parallel, merge the signals, and recommend which approach fits the household.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: diy-vs-hire-comparison
  title: DIY vs. hire-out cost and effort comparison
  description: Estimate DIY and hire-out paths in parallel, merge the signals, and recommend which approach fits the household.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Help a household decide whether to do a home project themselves or hire it out.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 3, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Project description and constraints
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions, including the project, the household's skill level, available time, and any budget ceiling. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: diy-estimator
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: DIY cost, time, and risk estimator
      role: Estimator sizing the do-it-yourself path for a home project.
      prompt: Describe what materials and tools the project would likely require and how to look up typical price ranges for them, estimate the time a person at the stated skill level would need, and flag safety, permit, or code risks that make the project unsuitable for DIY. Do not invent specific prices; describe where to check current costs and note the uncertainty in any estimate.
      capabilities: { skills: [domain-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: hire-estimator
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Hire-out cost and time estimator
      role: Estimator sizing the hire-a-professional path for a home project.
      prompt: Describe the typical scope of work a hired professional would cover for this project, how to gather comparable local quotes, and a rough turnaround time based on project complexity. Do not fabricate specific contractor names or prices; describe what to look up and how wide quote ranges typically are.
      capabilities: { skills: [domain-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: estimate-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel DIY and hire-out estimation
      config: { members: [diy-estimator, hire-estimator], execution: parallel, exit: aggregate }
    - id: merge-estimates
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge DIY and hire-out estimates
      config: { aggregation: merge }
    - id: recommendation
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: DIY vs. hire recommendation
      role: Independent evaluator weighing cost, time, and risk to recommend an approach.
      prompt: Weigh the merged DIY and hire-out estimates against the household's stated skill level, available time, and budget ceiling, and recommend which approach fits best. Return the recommendation with a score reflecting confidence and the concrete reasons behind it, including any risk factors that should override a purely cost-based choice.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.6 }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: DIY vs. hire recommendation with reasoning
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: estimate-group, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: estimate-group, to: merge-estimates, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: merge-estimates, to: recommendation, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: recommendation, to: result, kind: data }
